remarks: Available immediately for yearly, unfurnished lease. This wonderful, sun-filled Townhouse at Chesterfield II is a spacious, welcoming home. Enjoy the ease of living in a gated condo complex with gatehouse, pools, garage parking, storage room and more. This fresh, modern home sparkles with hardwood floors in the living spaces, vaulted ceilings, skylights, large windows and more. The open layout includes a white kitchen with abundant cabinets, large counter space, flowing into a dining area, and a large great room space. The first bedroom with a full bath, balcony, and walk-in closet is on this main level. Upstairs, a large loft overlooking the great room with a skylight, closet space and laundry room with full-size washer and dryer can be a wonderful home office, den, exercise room or hobby space. The primary bedroom suite has a large full bath and spacious walk-in closet. The carpeting was just professionally cleaned. There is an enclosed parking garage with reserved space for this unit, and a locked storage area. This entire home is in gleaming, move-in ready condition. Experience the comfort of this highly-desirable home available for lease. Tenant must have excellent credit.
